attribution: Drafted with AI; the gallery text is unsigned on the site
method: Grouped from direct inspection of all 134 archived PNGs on dated contact sheets, then each proposed gallery checked as one wall of images. Earlier labels, readings and gallery memberships were not consulted while grouping; old homes were compared only afterwards.
